scheme_name: Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) Tech Scheme
overview: HUDCO Tech Scheme is a technology-focused initiative by the Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) aimed at promoting innovation and sustainable development in urban infrastructure and housing sectors. The scheme supports the adoption of advanced technologies, green building practices, and smart city solutions through financial and technical assistance. It targets stakeholders involved in urban development projects seeking to integrate modern technological interventions for improved efficiency and environmental sustainability.
objectives: Promote adoption of innovative and sustainable technologies in housing and urban infrastructure
Support green building and energy-efficient construction practices
Facilitate smart city solutions and digital urban management systems
Encourage research and development in urban development technologies
Provide financial assistance for technology upgradation in ongoing and new projects
Enhance resilience and sustainability of urban habitats through tech integration
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include central/state government agencies, urban local bodies, public sector undertakings, housing boards, and private sector entities engaged in housing and urban infrastructure projects. Projects must demonstrate technological innovation, sustainability, and compliance with HUDCO’s lending norms. Priority is given to projects aligned with national missions such as Smart Cities, AMRUT, and Housing for All.
benefits: Benefits include concessional interest rates on loans, extended repayment tenors, technical advisory support for technology selection and implementation, assistance in accessing international best practices, and support for monitoring and evaluation of technology performance. The scheme also facilitates capacity building and knowledge sharing among stakeholders.
financial_support: HUDCO provides term loans covering up to 75% of the project cost for technology adoption in eligible projects. The financial support is structured as a rupee-term loan with interest rates linked to HUDCO’s benchmark rates, offering concessions for projects with high sustainability and innovation quotients. Repayment tenors can extend up to 15 years, including a moratorium period, based on project cash flows.
application_process: 1. Submit a detailed project proposal outlining the technology intervention, expected outcomes, and sustainability benefits. 2. Include project cost estimates, financing plan, and implementation timeline. 3. Provide clearances and approvals from relevant statutory authorities, if applicable. 4. Submit organizational and financial documents of the applicant entity. 5. HUDCO undertakes technical and financial appraisal of the proposal. 6. Upon approval, a loan sanction letter is issued with terms and conditions. 7. Disbursement occurs in stages based on project milestones and verification.
required_documents: Project proposal with technology details and cost breakdown
Project cost estimates and financing plan
Certificate of Incorporation / Registration of applicant entity
Audited financial statements of the applicant for last 3 years
Board resolution authorizing the project and loan application
Land title documents or project site details
Details of promoter contribution and equity stake
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to fund availability and appraisal timelines.
implementing_agency: Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO)
caveats: Loan approval is subject to HUDCO’s credit appraisal and risk assessment norms
Priority is given to projects with clear sustainability outcomes and technological innovation
Beneficiaries must ensure compliance with environmental and social safeguards
The scheme does not cover pure research or theoretical studies without field application
Concessional terms are contingent on meeting predefined performance indicators
